command.working_directory_scope: runner resolves <case-root> to this case directory before chdir; every relative plan, property, input, and output path is resolved below it

jvm_requirements.verification: A future oracle runner must verify JVM file.encoding=UTF-8 before execution; this static corpus does not infer it from the process locale.

bounds.enforcement: declared; not runtime-enforced by this static corpus

execution.raw_artifacts: oracle-runs/functions-files/basic/ (ignored; not generated in this task)

limitations: This manifest is a static corpus declaration; this task does not launch Java, JMeter, or a subprocess.
The output directory is case-local and ignored; the plan never names a machine path or ambient file.
The UDV and sampler StringFromFile occurrences intentionally share inputs/lines.txt so occurrence identity is observable.

The pinned JMeter 5.6.3 function documentation states that an unbounded StringFromFile sequence restarts at the beginning after EOF; the third iteration is therefore a source-backed recycle declaration, but no runtime oracle evidence is claimed.

Timing, byte counts, and Debug Sampler runtime lines are normalized; labels, line-valued file results, error sentinels, and XPath values remain observable. Multiline UTF-8/default/UTF-16 reads remain exact input and future-artifact contracts because the current debug projection parser cannot assert embedded newlines without loss.
